# Third-party files

These are bundled unmodified so Skylog works offline.

| File | Project | License |
|---|---|---|
| `d3.min.js` | [D3](https://d3js.org) v7.9.0 | ISC |
| `topojson-client.min.js` | [topojson-client](https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client) v3.1.0 | ISC |
| `countries-110m.json`, `countries-50m.json` | [world-atlas](https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas) v2.0.2, derived from [Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com) | ISC; Natural Earth data is public domain |
